changes.title: Camera timeline: drag the playhead across the whole day, with a readout
changes.detail:
The timeline only listened for press and release, so nothing moved while dragging, and in the 1 h and 6 h views the window re-centred on the new spot after every release. The red line could be coaxed across the day roughly the way a reluctant pet is coaxed into a carrier: half a window at a time, with complaints. Now the playhead follows the finger, the view stays still for the whole drag, and a bubble shows the exact time, whether that moment was recorded, and any event there. Letting go plays from there, or from the next recording in a gap.

Also: the camera recording page's open-rows key is classified for settings sync, and the filter chip menu's Cantonese strings are finally switched on.

changes.title: SSH access: review fixes (key parsing, revocation, private key clearing)
changes.detail: Key lines are parsed the way the SSH server reads them (type first, whole key body, line feed only), so a decoy key in an options prefix or an odd line separator cannot spoof a fingerprint. The full mode now runs dropbear only while a key is listed, ends every session when one is removed, binds to the container address, logs to docker logs and reports its published port. The list answers mode "unsupported" instead of a 404 the websocket relay would lose. Container writes are locked and keep comments; rejected keys are no longer echoed; a failed restore tries every key. The page clears a pasted private key even from an empty field, keeps errors where they were pressed, follows the language mode, offers Undo, and puts the add card right after the status on a phone.

changes.title: Camera recording: quieter, safer logs and a watchdog that watches the whole run
changes.detail: Group repeats of one ffmpeg failure by a normalised key (no process addresses or counters), write the ffmpeg lines once, space out reminders (10 min, 1 h, 6 h), and mask credentials by the exact known source plus passwords with slashes, quotes or at signs and secrets in paths and queries. The watchdog counts only the recorder's own segments, keeps watching for stalls, and a run is only a recovery after it stayed up; the retry backoff now escalates for flapping cameras. ffmpeg is ended if anything fails after it was spawned, TLS verification follows verify_ssl, and the place in logs and diagnostics no longer carries the user name or host.

changes.title: Install Marketplace packages by drag and drop, with automatic updates
changes.detail: Adds the .hapkg package: a ZIP with hapkg.json that lists title, version, source, an https update address and a SHA-256 for every file. The browser and the server both check it before anything is placed. Drop a package anywhere on the Marketplace page, or use "Install from a package file". Installed packages read their index every six hours, offer newer versions as update entities and, with "Update automatically" on, install them through the same checks: no downgrades, no domain swaps, a restart repair for integrations, and the old version kept when anything fails. An "Installed from a file" list on the Installed tab shows each package's state. Design boards are in design/canvases/44-integration-packages.
changes.detail_yue: 以後裝嘢唔使再打 repo 連結，成個檔案拎住掟落去就得，好似 Chrome 擴充咁。 每個檔案逐粒 checksum 對過先放行，想偷龍轉鳳換 domain 或者倒退版本？ 門都冇。自動更新出事都唔怕，舊版照樣坐得穩穩陣陣。

changes.title: Marketplace: carry an integration across a domain rename instead of refusing it
changes.detail: An update whose manifest moved to a new domain used to stop at Install with "uninstall it and install it again", which is advice, not an update. Now the Marketplace looks for a release that ships both the old and the new domain and installs that first, so the integration can migrate its own entries after a restart, then the normal update carries on. With no such release and nothing set up under the old domain it simply installs the new one and tidies the old folder away; with entries still there it raises a repair that asks before going ahead. Old folders are only removed once nothing uses them, and never when they are symlinks or belong to another repository.

changes.title: Grow light alerts, soil, energy and cards; morning briefing, safety cutoff and printer door
changes.detail:
Grow light now tells you things instead of making you check: a new growth stage, harvest time, watering due, a pump run, dry soil and a "sow the next batch" reminder go to any notify action, a grow_light_alert event and a new Alerts event entity. A soil moisture sensor can put a watering off while the pot is still wet and water as soon as it dries out, so the radishes stop swimming. Rated watts or the plug's own power sensor give Light energy and Light cost sensors; Next sowing and a Sown again button round it off. Two Lovelace cards (one crop, and every crop side by side) come from the boards.

changes.title: Checking for updates no longer installs the Supervisor [skip ci]

Reported by the owner: with automatic updates switched off, pressing "Check for updates" installed an update anyway. The Supervisor has a self-update setting of its own, on by default, that fires after every refresh of the version list, at its own start, on its daily reload and when the channel changes. The switches on the Updates page never touched it, so "off" was more of a suggestion.

Now there is one installer per part. The Supervisor's own setting defaults to off, and Core turns it off on existing installs at every refresh; if that cannot be confirmed, the check skips asking the Supervisor to reload, so looking cannot install. The Supervisor is installed only by a press of Update, or by the owner's own switch inside its window with its waiting days and backup choice. The page shows a warning with "Turn off now" if the Supervisor still reports its own setting as on.

Side effects, on purpose: Supervisor plugins no longer update on a schedule; they update as part of an install someone started, and the repair of a missing plugin at start is unchanged. Restoring a backup from a newer Supervisor now asks for the Supervisor to be updated first instead of doing it silently.
